title: first 5-minute mix
system_instruction_addendum: FIRST 5-MIN MIX ADDENDUM: User picks tracks freely. Suggest one grounded move per minute. Count-ins require [cue:] evidence; otherwise narrate retrospectively.

tutor_speak.text: load two tracks, pick what you want, and start mixing. i'll suggest one grounded move per minute.
i'll cite what i hear. if i don't have evidence for a forward call, i'll talk about what already happened.

hints.text: load a track on deck a, then on deck b. start playing deck a.
mix when you're ready. five minutes total. i'll narrate around what your hands are doing.
tap continue when the five minutes are done.
